What these captures establish

Both models use the game’s procedural builder and materials. The first-pass comparison preserves all earlier revisions; the current left image is the original. Shared camera bounds are recalculated when the candidate shape changes. Each pair shares a bounding box, orthographic camera and studio lights. This isolates geometry and color from the moving game environment. The silhouette view removes surface color and outlines. In-game lighting, bloom and perspective will look different.

Build and browser verification are recorded with this review. These are not frame-rate measurements or a claim of photographic accuracy. Role variants identify their source craft and distinguish invented gameplay loadouts from screen-seen designs.

References: SG-1 stills from the linked Lexicon, Stargate Project and GateWorld pages, plus licensed Prometheus model photographs from Master Replicas; each source is linked above. No downloaded models or asset packs were used.

Choices stay in this browser. Nothing is applied to the game.
